entities.summary: Muhammad Bashir Jehangiri Swati was Chief Justice of the Supreme Court of Pakistan from 7 January 2002 to 31 January 2002. Previously, he served as Chief Justice of the Peshawar High Court. He did his 20 years of law practice at Peshawar High Court and the Supreme Court of Pakistan.
